title: YouTube Transcript with FlashData
description: Read existing YouTube captions as timestamped text; defaults to English automatic captions. Uses FlashData Credits; Apify usage is separate. API key: https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys

video_id.title: Video Id
video_id.description: 11-character YouTube video ID (the v= value in a watch URL).

flashdataApiKey.title: FlashData API key
flashdataApiKey.description: Requires youtube_transcript access. Get your key: https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys

language.title: Language
language.description: Existing caption language, e.g. en, de or es. No translation.

auto.description: true selects automatic captions; false selects uploader captions. No fallback.
auto.title: Auto
